metadata.description: tipb47's Claude Code skills — sprint-directed multi-agent methodology, session status, and session handoffs.

plugins.name: my-claude-skills
plugins.description: Everything in this repo as one plugin: /sprint (sprint-directed multi-agent methodology), /whereami (session situation report), /handoff (one-message session transfer).

plugins.name: sprint-director
plugins.description: Sprint-directed multi-agent development methodology. A fresh director session per sprint spawns isolated track subagents on their own branches, audits their diffs against a design contract, merges in order, and keeps a living state ledger. Humans appear only at explicit operator gates.

plugins.name: whereami
plugins.description: In-chat situation report for the current session: what is done, what is in progress, what comes next.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: One-message session handoff: a single copyable message that lets a fresh agent verify state, grill the operator, and continue the work.
